name: data-frame-envelope
description: The 24-byte envelope, network byte order: version 1, flags (bit 0 the direction), stream 0, length, seq and a nanosecond timestamp, both u64; then the payload, unframed. One output frame stamped by the worker and one input frame stamped by the core. The .bin file is the ground truth: a decoder must reproduce these fields from it and an encoder these bytes from them.
